impacts: Production publishing affects the shared OAuth project, including existing sign-in and Drive clients.
External authorizations are not restricted to the Testing user list after publishing; application approval remains required.
If unverified sensitive/restricted scopes are used, unverified-app warnings and the lifetime OAuth user cap may remain.
Google production status removes the Testing-specific seven-day rule; individual tokens can still be revoked or expire for other reasons.
Gmail readonly and existing full Drive are restricted scopes; verification or a valid exemption must be assessed without assuming internal business use is sufficient.
